svg.aria-label: Reddit high level design: clients reach a single API gateway, which routes to ten services, those services read and write polyglot storage, and Kafka carries indexing, notifications and spam checks off the request path
svg.text: One entry point, ten services that own their own data, polyglot storage, and an event stream for work that can wait.
the client hits one gateway, which routes to the service that owns that data
the CDN serves media and public pages, Redis serves hot feeds and counts
SQL where consistency matters, NoSQL where volume matters, objects for media
Kafka carries indexing, notifications and spam checks off the request path
